column1: # Hemistichs as Finn Thiesen scans them in A Manual of Classical Persian Prosody
# (1982), pp. 11–171: every whole Persian hemistich, transcribed from the page.
# Every row has to fit its metre (aruz_eval.realizes).
# line: Ganjoor's text when the hemistich is in the 2026-08-03 snapshot (doc_id
# set), else the book's. provenance: page and paragraph.
# pronunciation: syllables split by ".", words by spaces; a e o short, â i u long,
# ē ō ā lengthened by the metre, ĭ ŭ shortened, one character per consonant
# (š č x ġ ž, ' for glottal and ʿayn), S an overlong syllable; ey is -e + ezāfe.
# Not included: quoted Arabic, the fragments of §§52–53, and §236's second line.
